newsitem.title: FINLAND: Cowed bull runs rings round Finnish farmer.
newsitem.headline: Cowed bull runs rings round Finnish farmer.

text.p: Finnish media are hot on the trail of Liekki the reluctant bull, lost in the forests three months after turning tail and fleeing at the sight of a field of cows.

The daily Helsingin Sanomat on Friday splashed an exclusive sighting of the bashful beast on its front page, after its photographer had more success than the vets who have tried in vain to capture the animal.
"He's a very nice, tender, timid bull," farmer Esko Hiltunen said. He bought 800 kg (1,700 lb) Liekki, which is Finnish for flame, in late May for $1,800, but lost him a week later.
